name: @pipeworx/mcp-openrouter

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List LLMs from the OpenRouter catalog (~340 models across all major providers) with normalized $/1M-token pricing, context windows, and modality. Filter by search, free-only, minimum context, or modality (e.g. "image" for vision models). Sorted cheapest-first by completion price. Keyless.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match against model id, name, and description. e.g. "claude", "gpt-4o", "deepseek".

free_only.description: If true, only return models whose prompt price is $0 (free tier).

min_context.description: Minimum context_length in tokens, e.g. 100000 or 200000.

modality.description: Substring match on architecture.modality, e.g. "image" to find vision/multimodal models, "text->text" for text-only.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Get full details for one OpenRouter model by id — normalized $/1M pricing (prompt, completion, plus per-request/image/web-search costs), context window, modality, supported parameters, tokenizer, knowledge cutoff. e.g. id "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5". Keyless.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of pricing ($/1M tokens), context window, and modality for 2-5 OpenRouter models. Answers "is claude-sonnet-4.5 cheaper than gpt-4o". Keyless.

ids.description: Array of 2-5 exact model ids, e.g. ["anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5", "openai/gpt-4o"].

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-openrouter forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the openrouter pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
